morphology.pattern_note: 输入保留小写检索形式 saw；规范写法为 SAW。它是祈愿语的缩写，不是普通词根的派生词；音标表示展开后的马来语常见读法，不是把 saw 读成一个英语音节。is_root 沿用输入标记。

senses.zh_definition: Sallallahualaihiwasallam 的缩写，意为“愿真主赐福并赐予他平安”，通常置于先知穆罕默德的名字或称谓之后。
senses.en_definition: An abbreviation of an invocation asking Allah to bless the Prophet Muhammad and grant him peace.
senses.ms_definition: Kependekan bagi Sallallahualaihiwasallam, iaitu doa memohon keberkatan dan kesejahteraan Allah untuk Nabi Muhammad.
senses.nuances: 输入中的 DBP 核心释义为 kep Sallallahualaihiwasallam。DBP 用法说明采用大写 SAW。此处 particle 仅用于适配所给词性选项；严格说来，它是宗教祈愿语的书面缩写，不是普通马来语语气助词，也不是英语 saw。[DBP：SAW](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=saw), [DBP：展开形式与用法](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=Sallallahualaihiwasallam)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Ceramah sempena Maulidur Rasul itu membincangkan akhlak Nabi Muhammad SAW.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这场配合圣纪节举办的讲座探讨了先知穆罕默德的品德，愿真主赐福并赐予他平安。
dual_scenarios.en: The lecture marking the Prophet's birthday discussed the character of the Prophet Muhammad, may Allah bless him and grant him peace.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kau nak ikut ceramah pasal akhlak Nabi Muhammad SAW malam ni?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah kamu mahu menghadiri ceramah tentang akhlak Nabi Muhammad SAW pada malam ini?
dual_scenarios.zh: 你今晚要一起去听讲先知穆罕默德品德的讲座吗？愿真主赐福并赐予他平安。
dual_scenarios.en: Do you want to come to tonight's talk about the character of the Prophet Muhammad, may Allah bless him and grant him peace?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Nak, aku dah kosongkan jadual. Jumpa kat masjid lepas Maghrib, ya.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya mahu hadir dan sudah melapangkan jadual. Kita berjumpa di masjid selepas solat Maghrib.
messages.zh: 去，我已经把时间空出来了。昏礼后在清真寺见。
messages.en: Yes, I've cleared my schedule. See you at the mosque after Maghrib prayers.

etymology.historical_story: SAW abbreviates an Arabic prayer conventionally written after the name of the Prophet Muhammad. Malay dictionaries give its expanded form as Sallallahualaihiwasallam. Its role is devotional: it expresses a wish for blessing and peace rather than adding a surname or academic title. DBP guidance specifies uppercase SAW, preserving a recognizable written convention. [DBP guidance](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=Sallallahualaihiwasallam)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到名字后的 SAW，就把三个字母展开成一句祝祷：Sallallahualaihiwasallam，愿真主赐福并赐予他平安。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 这是尊敬先知的宗教祈愿语。书写时通常置于 Nabi Muhammad 或 Rasulullah 之后；朗读时宜读出完整祈愿语。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于相关宗教叙述、讲座和日常信仰交流。不要把它当作普通人的通用尊称、玩笑标签或商业装饰，也不要与用于其他人物或用于真主之后的敬语混用。
